notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first runs through «حدثنا أبي ح» and the second through «وحدثنا ابن بشار»; the names after «حدثنا شعبة» are written once, so they are the shared tail
«عمه» with no name is a relation link; the act of the uncle is the saying and the Prophet is the end
«ثم ذكر معنى حديث مسدد» is a reference to another report, not a route
